My husband and I recently traveled from Atlantic Canada through several cities with our dog, a Rough Collie. Planning a road trip with a large pup can be stressful, but Les Anges Gardiennes made the entire process seamless.
I called them about a month before our trip, and right from the start, they were incredibly friendly and thoroughly professional. They clearly explained the entire boarding process and made sure all the necessary vaccination records and details were organized well in advance, which gave us immense peace of mind.
Our dog stayed with them for two days, and she absolutely loved it! Because of the long travel, she was already quite tired when we arrived. Furthermore, she has osteoarthritis, so her mobility isn't the greatest. The wonderful team here understood her medical situation perfectly. They went above and beyond to ensure she was completely comfortable, giving her plenty of love, attention, and gentle pets.
We are so grateful for their exceptional care, empathy, and professionalism. They truly live up to their name as guardian angels! We highly recommend them to anyone looking for top-notch care for their furry family members.

This daycare is AMAZING!! Romeo literally starts losing his mind (in the best way 😂) as soon as we get close to the door, biggest smile, little happy dances… I swear he forgets I exist the second he walks in!The staff are absolute Angels. You can tell they genuinely love every dog like their own,there’s always cuddles, playtime, and so much attention. It gives me so much peace of mind knowing he’s not just being watched, he’s being truly cared for.They’re also incredible with communication, sending pictures (which honestly make my whole day), following his food restrictions perfectly, and always greeting us with the warmest smiles.I’ve tried other daycares around the area, but nothing even comes close. Finding this place felt like hitting the jackpot.If you love your dog like family (or let’s be real… more than most humans 😅), this is THE place to go!

Les Anges Gardiennes Pet Care NDG staff are truly Angels; they care for and love our puppy. As a new dog owner, after visiting Les Anges Gardiennes Pet Care in NDG and speaking with the staff, I left my puppy there in their care for a day without hesitation. The dedication to all the pets they care for demonstrates how much they love what they do. The updates and pictures I got throughout the day were reassuring and sincere. They also took perfect-quality pictures, which is a bonus. It's adorable how they wrote the updates to us as if he wrote them. They are honest and don't hide anything. Not every dog wants to play, and my puppy tried playing with a grumpy dog, and they told us about it. They love what they do and genuinely care, which is not what I experienced at other daycares where I felt my puppy was just a number. When I went to pick up my puppy, he was the last pet left, and the staff was cleaning the daycare as it was the end of the day. Instead of putting my puppy in a cage or crate while they tried to clean up after a long day, they had my puppy follow them as they cleaned together, which made it a playful bonding experience together as they were cleaning. This shows that they love and interact with my puppy despite trying to clean up after the day. He was treated as their pet. They have patience and love, which is why they are Angels. I also noticed a positive attitude and change in behaviour with my puppy when he came home, which told me how good it was for him to spend the day with them. I will bring him back weekly as he will benefit from it due to the excellent care and fun he has there with the other pets and staff. I want to thank them for what they do for us and highly recommend them, knowing you can trust them with our pets. May 5th, 2025 additional review: Despite my Dog only visiting the daycare once, he did not even have the chance to become a regular visitor yet; in my care at home, he suffered a fractured leg, which delayed him from visiting the daycare for several weeks, I informed the daycare of his fracture. They called me 3 times, going out of their way to find out how my dog was doing and recovering. They are truly Angels and care about our pets; they do not make you feel like a client or a number. They truly have passion for what they are doing. This is what sets them apart from my past experiences with other daycares in the past.
